Class SBScenarios

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.gametest.SBScenarios
final class SBScenarios extends Object
Cross-loader Source Bucket scenarios; each loader wraps every method as a GameTest. Player scenarios right-click through GameTestSupport.useItem(Player, InteractionHand), SharedGameTestSupport.clickBlock(Player, InteractionHand, BlockHitResult), or GameTestSupport.interactWithEntity(Player, Entity, InteractionHand).
